scope: Every71398 QC retained spot/all814 frozen candidates; no clinical or score-based selection. Mixed spots, no cell-type assignments. All19 source libraries, patient bridge unreviewed.
fixed_TF_readout: All74 source-frozen DDIT3 targets excluding original receiverMCP/LR. Official positive, negative and signed UCell(w_neg=1,negative results clipped0) all saved. RNA proxy distinct from original gene-Z ULM or TF protein. No variable readout or sign selected after tissue effects.
next_gate: Independently replay all raw count tied-rank scores and metadata; audit composition/reference/regions before planning any spatial association. Never equate same-spot coexpression with direct interaction.
empty_TF_component: If prior has no targets of one sign, that component is mathematically zero and is labelled by target count0; never interpreted as measured biological absence.
